name: llvm-mingw
summary: LLVM 23.1.4's Clang, lld and tools with mingw-w64 (UCRT), libc++ and compiler-rt, llvm-mingw's build for x86_64 Windows, as a C and C++ toolchain for builds
license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND ZPL-2.1 AND MIT AND ISC

modules.name: reproducible
build: cd "$PREFIX/x86_64-w64-mingw32/lib" && rm libc++.dll.a libunwind.dll.a libpthread.dll.a libwinpthread.dll.a libwinpthread.la libomp.dll.a

printf '%s\n' '# zigsaw: no time in the objects Clang writes or the programs lld links, so that builds are reproducible.' '-mno-incremental-linker-compatible' '-Wl,--no-insert-timestamp' >> "$PREFIX/bin/mingw32-common.cfg"
printf 'int main(void) { return 0; }\n' > t.c && cc -Werror -c t.c -o t1.o && cc -s t.c -o t1.exe && sleep 2 && cc -Werror -c t.c -o t2.o && cc -s t.c -o t2.exe && cmp t1.o t2.o && cmp t1.exe t2.exe
printf '#include <thread>\nint main() { std::thread t([] {}); t.join(); }\n' > t.cpp && c++ -s t.cpp -o t.exe && ! llvm-objdump -p t.exe | grep -iE 'DLL Name: lib(c\+\+|unwind|winpthread)'
